description: This Java source file defines the DictionaryProvider class, which extends ContentProvider to provide access to a dictionary database, handling search, suggestions, and word retrieval functionalities within an Android application.

classes.name: DictionaryProvider
classes.description: An Android ContentProvider that supplies dictionary data, handles search suggestions, and word lookups.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the DictionaryDatabase instance when the provider is created.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Handles search and suggestion queries based on the URI pattern, returning relevant cursor data.

methods.name: getSuggestions
methods.description: Retrieves suggestion matches for a given query string.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search for words matching the query string.

methods.name: getWord
methods.description: Retrieves a specific word and its definition based on the URI.

methods.name: refreshShortcut
methods.description: Refreshes a shortcut suggestion, if applicable.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type for a given URI pattern.
